# Blackmagic DeckLink SDK 16.0 — interface definitions

The files in `include/` are the COM interface definitions (`.idl`) and the version header of the
**Blackmagic DeckLink SDK 16.0**, unchanged, as published by Blackmagic Design at
https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/developer/product/capture-and-playback.

They are Copyright (c) 2026 Blackmagic Design and are distributed under the license written at the top of
each file, together with the DeckLink SDK End User License Agreement
(https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/EULA/DeckLinkSDK). The build compiles them with `midl` to talk to the
Desktop Video driver; no sample code of the SDK is used.

They are **not** covered by the MIT License of this repository.
